basics.name: Dmitry Ivanov
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary: Software engineer focused on high-performance web applications, real-time audio, and 2D/3D graphics. Built fintech products at Mobeewave, Apple, and Brainfinance, voice interfaces at ElevenLabs, and scientific visualization at Plotly. Current open-source work covers WebGL, WebAssembly, DSP, and color. Trained in control systems and signal processing.

work.name: Independent
work.summary: Open-source graphics, audio, and WebAssembly; selected projects total 3,000+ GitHub stars.
highlights: [gl-waveform](https://github.com/dy/gl-waveform): WebGL2 time-series renderer; 60 fps over 172.8M samples per channel, exact per-pixel peaks, streaming input
[audio](https://github.com/audiojs/audio): streaming audio engine; 10 GB+ files paged to OPFS, runs in a Worker; 300+ GitHub stars
[JZ](https://github.com/dy/jz) / [watr](https://github.com/dy/watr): JavaScript-to-WebAssembly compiler and WAT optimizer, benchmarked against C, Rust, and Go
[color-space](https://github.com/colorjs/color-space): 168 verified color spaces for JS, WebAssembly, and shaders; 380+ GitHub stars
[gpu-font](https://github.com/dy/gpu-font): in-browser font identification on WebGPU; right family in the top five 92% of the time
Go backend (Gin, GORM, SQLite) for ISKCON Montréal

work.name: Brainfinance
work.summary: Consumer fintech serving 100,000+ users in Canada: icash.ca loans and earna.zone savings.
highlights: Owned the earna.zone frontend on Next.js: landing, dashboard, application flows, and design system (shadcn, Tailwind, Storybook)
Rebuilt icash.ca loan application and contract signing; contract drop-off fell 40% in an A/B test
Raised key flows above 95 in PageSpeed; fixed WCAG AA accessibility issues

work.name: ElevenLabs
highlights: Launched elevenlabs.io: 11ty, Firebase auth, Stripe payments, voice API access
Built the browser player for generated speech

work.name: [Mobeewave](https://www.linkedin.com/company/mobeewave/about/) / [Apple](https://www.apple.com)
work.summary: Joined Mobeewave in 2019 and continued at Apple after the 2020 acquisition.

Reference [polyfill](https://github.com/dy/template-parts) for the W3C Template Instantiation proposal

work.name: Plotly

WebGL scatter, line, scatterplot-matrix, and waveform renderers
Maintained [regl](https://github.com/regl-project/regl) (5,500+ GitHub stars) and 24 [gl-vis](https://github.com/gl-vis) repositories
Visual-regression tooling for 2,000+ chart variants
